items.title_en: New AI Model Helps Predictive Models Work Across Different Databases
summary_en: Web platforms store data in different database formats, making it hard to reuse AI models between them. Researchers created MoREGT, a new system that uses graph transformers to improve model transfer with less training data.
The system represents database rows and cells as tokens and adds features like row age to enhance performance.
key_points_en: Different database schemas create transfer challenges
MREGT uses graph transformers for cross-database learning
The model requires less pretraining data than previous methods
translation_zh: 网络平台使用不同格式的数据库，使得AI模型难以在不同平台间复用。研究人员开发了MREGT系统，利用图变压器在较少训练数据下提升模型迁移能力。
该系统将数据库行和单元格表示为标记，并添加如行年龄等特征来增强性能。

items.title_en: Superfluid: A New Local AI Server for Efficient LLM Inference
summary_en: Running large language models locally protects data privacy, reduces costs, and works without internet. Superfluid solves challenges of sharing models on single devices and using underused hardware across multiple devices.
The system supports both single-device and multi-device setups while optimizing resource usage across different machines.
key_points_en: Local LLMs keep data private and reduce costs
Superfluid handles both single-device and multi-device scenarios
It utilizes idle machines across different vendors
translation_zh: 在本地运行大型语言模型可以保护数据隐私，降低成本，并且无需联网。Superfluid解决了在单个设备上共享模型以及跨多个设备使用未充分利用的硬件的挑战。
该系统支持单设备和多设备设置，同时优化不同机器上的资源使用。

items.title_en: Tracking AI Behavior in Real Time: New Method Revealed
summary_en: Current AI security checks focus on static data like model weights, not real-time GPU processes.
Researchers developed a way to analyze live LLM behavior without stopping or changing the model.
The method uses a six-step process with platform-specific tools to capture hidden states.
key_points_en: Uses non-modifying debugger to examine live GPU data
Works without knowing model architecture details
Captures per-layer residual-stream activations
translation_zh: 当前AI安全检查关注静态数据如模型权重，而非实时GPU进程。
研究人员开发出在不中断或修改模型情况下分析LLM行为的方法。
该方法使用六步骤流程和平台特定工具捕获隐藏状态。

vocab.zh: 不修改系统的调试工具

items.title_en: Anthropic's IPO Offers Hope for Struggling AI Sector
summary_en: Anthropic's IPO is seen as crucial for the tech industry, which has heavily invested in the AI lab.
The industry is seeking positive momentum after facing challenges in the AI trade.
key_points_en: Anthropic's IPO has outsized importance
Tech industry is heavily invested in the AI lab
Market needs positive momentum after struggles
translation_zh: Anthropic的IPO被视为对科技行业至关重要的事件，该行业已大量投资于这家人工智能实验室。
在人工智能交易遭遇挑战后，市场亟需积极的动量。

items.title_en: Trump's accounts sold up to $1 million in Nvidia stock after White House briefing
summary_en: Trump's accounts sold up to $1 million in Nvidia stock five days after being briefed about Jensen Huang's ties to a suspected Chinese spy.
The timing suggests potential influence from the White House meeting on stock trading decisions.
key_points_en: Up to $1 million in Nvidia stock sold
Sale occurred five days after briefing
Linked to Huang's relationship with suspected spy
translation_zh: 特朗普的账户在被简·黄与疑似中国间谍的关系简报后五天内出售了价值高达100万美元的英伟达股票。
交易时间表明白宫会议可能影响了股票交易决策。

items.title_en: Hedge Fund Bets on AI Stocks Before Market Drop
summary_en: A hedge fund nearly collapsed in summer but bought AI stocks before their prices fell.
The fund made investments in AI companies ahead of a market downturn in October.
key_points_en: Hedge fund faced near collapse over summer
Purchased AI stocks before share prices dropped
Investments made before October market rout
translation_zh: 对冲基金在夏季几乎破产，但在此之前购买了人工智能股票。
该基金在十月股市下跌前投资了人工智能公司。

items.title_en: Apple Introduces Face Unlock Feature for iPhone Duo, Not Face ID
summary_en: Apple has introduced a limited face unlock feature in the iOS 27.3 developer beta for the iPhone Duo.
This feature is distinct from Face ID and is part of ongoing improvements to the operating system.
key_points_en: iOS 27.3 beta includes face unlock for iPhone Duo
Feature differs from Face ID technology
Update is part of iOS development improvements
translation_zh: 苹果在iOS 27.3开发者预览版中为iPhone Duo引入了有限的面部解锁功能。
该功能不同于Face ID，是操作系统持续改进的一部分。

items.title_en: Instagram Expands Affiliate Link Options for Creators
summary_en: Instagram now allows creators to include Amazon affiliate links in Reels and feed posts, expanding previous options like stories and DMs.
This update helps creators promote products more directly through their main content areas.
The feature aims to increase sales opportunities for content creators.
key_points_en: Affiliate links can now be added to Reels and feed posts
Previously used in stories and DMs
Helps creators boost product sales
translation_zh: Instagram现在允许创作者在Reels和动态帖子中添加亚马逊联盟链接，扩展了之前的故事和私信功能
此更新帮助创作者通过主要内容区域更直接地推广产品
该功能旨在增加内容创作者的销售机会

items.title_en: Robotics startup with Eric Trump support fails to pay employees, risks bankruptcy
summary_en: A robotics company backed by Eric Trump failed to pay its employees' salaries, one year after its CEO used company funds to buy a luxury home.
The startup is now facing possible collapse due to financial mismanagement.
key_points_en: Startup missed employee payroll payments
CEO spent funds on a luxury home
Company risks bankruptcy
translation_zh: 一家获得埃里克·特朗普支持的机器人公司未能支付员工工资，这发生在CEO一年前用公司资金购买豪华住宅之后。
由于财务管理不善，该公司现在面临破产风险。
